title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is a scratch page written in pen on the back of a typed SGA 7 Exposé IX sheet (the mirror-image typed text shows through). It works out elementary homological algebra for computing the value of an additive functor T on a module R from a presentation P → Q → R.

(1) Covariant, right exact T. Split the sequence P → Q → R into two short pieces:
- Z = Im(P → Q), giving 0 → Z → Q → Z' → 0;
- Z' = Im(Q → R), with Z' ⊂ R.
Right exactness gives T(P) → T(Q) → T(Z') → 0, so T(Z') ≅ T(Q)/I, where I is the image of T(P) (equivalently of T(Z)). The '∫ ?' arrow from T(Z') down to T(R) asks whether this map is injective. The marginal words ('transfert en régulier', 'régulier') seem to ask when Z' ↪ R is preserved, i.e. when T is exact enough or R/Z' is nice.

(2) Contravariant, left exact T, e.g. Hom(−, M). From P → Q → I ↪ R one gets 0 → T(I) → T(Q) → T(P), so T(I) = Ker(T(Q) → T(P)). Grothendieck jots Hom(P, M) and Hom(Δ, Hom(P, M)), apparently thinking of a simplicial resolution P_• and the cosimplicial object Hom(P_•, M). He crosses out Hom(RΓ(P), M).

(3) An explicit case, apparently the divided power algebra on one generator over ℤ (the topic of the cote). Take Q = ℤ^{(ℕ)} with basis e_k and P = ℤ^{(ℕ×ℕ)} with basis indexed by pairs (k, l). The map is (λ_{k,l}) ↦ Σ λ_{k,l}(c_{k,l} e_{k+l} − …), with c_{i,k−i} binomial-type coefficients encoding the multiplication e_k e_l = c_{k,l} e_{k+l}. Dualizing with Hom(−, ℤ) or Hom(−, ℚ) gives sequences (ν_k)_{k≥0}, and the hatched expression Σ c_{i,k−i} ν_k is the dual condition. This is the standard duality between divided powers and a polynomial/coalgebra structure, or a check of a T(R) computation for Γ(ℤ).

All of this is routine scratch work supporting the 1976 IHÉS lecture on the divided-power de Rham complex.
errors: Nothing wrong as such. The question mark on T(Z') → T(R) correctly flags that injectivity fails in general for right exact T: one needs Tor-vanishing or flatness of R/Z'.

ideas.what: Computing T(R) from a presentation P → Q → R via right/left exactness: T(Z') = T(Q)/Im T(P), and T(I) = Ker(T(Q) → T(P)) for contravariant left exact T

ideas.what: Explicit presentation of the divided power algebra Γ_ℤ(x) by generators e_k and relations e_k e_l = binomial·e_{k+l}, and its dual
ideas.modern_name: Divided power algebra and duality with the symmetric algebra

deep.surprise_reason: Routine homological scratch work on a reused SGA 7 typescript sheet; nothing beyond standard material.
transcription_corrections: The first-line arrows are mixed: 'P → Q — Z' → 0' and 'Z' → R' should read Z' ↪ R (an inclusion).
The word before 'T' is probably 'covariant T' for the first part (right exact covariant), with a contravariant T used later; the reading is uncertain.
The marginal notes likely read 'voit dans régulier en de inversé' / 'transfert en régulier' and are largely illegible; 'hom' is probably 'Hom'.
The bottom formula has indices k ∈ ℕ, l ≥ 0 and coefficients c_{k,l} (written c_{gh} in the transcription); the target is likely the dual (ν_k)_{k≥0} with Σ c_{i,k−i} ν_k inside the hatched region.
